paragraphs.text:
The window opens smoothly, and you enter. You try to move as 
quietly as possible: attempt a Stealth roll:
• If you fail, go to 51.
• If you succeed, you realize that you have no idea where Gliere’s 
room is. You go upstairs. All the doors are closed; none have 
names on them. To try one, go to 51. To leave the house, go 
to any Arkham Location. 
(28, 90)
